policy: Only enumerated description replacements are allowed; restore before-values for original semantic hash comparison. No approval or finding closure implied.

amendments.before: Verifies asset recognition criteria: past event, resource control, future economic benefits — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied asset-recognition assertion. An asset definition check alone is insufficient: explicit relevance, faithful representation and uncertainty assessments are required, subject to applicable specific-section precedence. This recognizer does not determine or post recognition. ASSET_RECOGNIZED is a legacy assertion label, not proof of recognition criteria; ASSET_REJECTED does not settle later recognition or explanatory disclosure.

amendments.before: Verifies liability recognition criteria: present obligation, economic outflow, reliable estimate — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied liability-recognition assertion. Definition, relevance, faithful representation and existence/measurement uncertainty judgments are separate requirements, with applicable specific sections taking precedence. This recognizer does not determine or post recognition. LIABILITY_RECOGNIZED is a legacy assertion label, not proof of recognition criteria; LIABILITY_REJECTED is not a substitute for specific-section analysis.

amendments.before: Evaluates economic substance over legal form for complex transactions — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied economic-substance assertion. Where legal form differs from substance, legal form alone does not faithfully represent the phenomenon; unresolved representation requires evidence and review. This recognizer does not authorize legal form to override substance. LEGAL_FORM_PREVAILS is retained solely as a legacy identifier and must be interpreted as UNRESOLVED_SUBSTANCE_MISMATCH, never an acceptable accounting policy choice.

amendments.before: Verifies compliance with Third Edition effective date (1 January 2027 with early adoption permitted) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied third-edition applicability assertion for annual periods beginning on or after 2027-01-01, or earlier application with required disclosure. Edition, reporting-period and disclosure evidence must be separately verified; this is not full-compliance certification. PREVIOUS_EDITION_ACTIVE is a historical assertion label; it neither selects an edition automatically nor permits previous-edition application after the effective date.

amendments.before: Enforces required note disclosure when entity early adopts Third Edition — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied early-application disclosure assertion. For annual periods beginning before 2027-01-01, third-edition application requires an explicit election and disclosure; missing evidence stays unresolved. This recognizer does not create or verify a disclosure by itself. STANDARD_EFFECTIVE_DATE is a legacy alternate assertion label; absence of early-application evidence does not prove that the reporting period is effective.

amendments.before: Evaluates whether fiduciary holding is merely incidental — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied fiduciary-activity assertion. Public accountability turns on holding assets for a broad group of outsiders as a primary business; incidental activity alone does not establish it. Amount/materiality is not a substitute for this business-purpose assessment. MATERIAL_FIDUCIARY is a legacy label requiring primary-versus-incidental evidence, not an amount threshold. Accounting conclusions require independently reviewed evidence; no posting is performed.

amendments.before: Assesses undue cost or effort exemption documentation and quantitative criteria — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied undue-cost-or-effort assertion. Relief requires an express exemption and dated entity-specific management judgment of incremental cost/effort against user benefits, assessed anew where subsequent relief applies. Disclose the fact and reasons, with the specific 19.16/19.38 disclosure exception assessed separately. No universal numeric cutoff is implied. Accounting conclusions require independently reviewed evidence; no posting is performed.

amendments.before: Applies bid price for asset positions and ask price for liability positions — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied representative-price assertion. Use the price within the bid–ask spread most representative of fair value in the circumstances; asset-bid/liability-ask is permitted, not required. Supported mid-market or other market-participant conventions may apply. The recognizer does not calculate fair value. Accounting conclusions require independently reviewed evidence; no posting is performed.

amendments.before: Applies 10-year useful life presumption when intangible life cannot be estimated reliably — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied finite-useful-life assertion. All intangible assets have finite useful lives; when life cannot be established reliably, management uses its best estimate not exceeding ten years. Ten is a cap, never an automatic default. The indefinite-life machine identifier is retained solely for compatibility; legal/contractual limits remain separately applicable. Accounting conclusions require independently reviewed evidence; no posting is performed.

amendments.before: Amortises goodwill over useful life (or 10 years if unestimable) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied goodwill useful-life assertion. If life cannot be established reliably, use management’s best estimate not exceeding ten years, never an automatic ten-year assignment. Amortisation and impairment require their applicable separate assessments; this recognizer performs no financial calculation. Accounting conclusions require independently reviewed evidence; no posting is performed.

amendments.before: Recognizes actuarial gains and losses immediately in OCI — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied actuarial-gains/losses assertion within the documented OCI election. The Standard also permits a profit-or-loss election; either policy applies consistently to all defined benefit plans and all actuarial gains/losses in their period of occurrence. This OCI-labelled recognizer does not mandate OCI or represent the profit-or-loss pathway by itself. Accounting conclusions require independently reviewed evidence; no posting is performed.

amendments.before: Tests whether lease term is for major part of economic life (e.g. >= 75%) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied major-part economic-life assessment within qualitative finance/operating lease classification at inception. The Standard mandates no 75% cutoff; examples and indicators are not conclusive. Document substance, transfer of substantially all risks and rewards, and countervailing features; a ratio alone does not determine classification. Native behavior is an assertion recognizer; it performs no posting or release.

amendments.before: Tests whether PV of minimum lease payments is substantially all fair value (e.g. >= 90%) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied substantially-all fair-value assessment within qualitative finance/operating lease classification. No 90% cutoff is mandated. Assess risks and rewards and countervailing features at inception; this ratio recognizer alone does not classify the lease. Native behavior is an assertion recognizer; it performs no posting or release.

amendments.before: Initializes ROU asset at PV of lease payments plus direct costs and restoration obligations — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied SME finance-lease initial-measurement assertion for a lessee after evidenced classification. Use the lower of inception fair value and present value of minimum lease payments as the liability/base asset amount; add qualifying initial direct costs to the asset. Use the implicit rate if determinable, otherwise the incremental borrowing rate. The legacy ROU identifier does not import a full-IFRS measurement model or operating-lease capitalization. Native behavior is an assertion recognizer; it performs no posting or release.

amendments.before: Verifies unreserved statement of compliance with IFRS for SMEs — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied compliance assertion only; its token does not establish an unreserved compliance statement. The connected workflow must verify an approved complete requirement/disclosure inventory, exact current reviewed evidence, eligibility, edition and statement bundle, with unresolved requirements blocking readiness. A separate independent accounting conclusion and release authorization remain required. Native behavior is an assertion recognizer; it performs no posting or release.

amendments.before: Measures derivative financial instruments at fair value through profit or loss — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied derivative measurement through profit or loss assertion under Section 11 of the February 2025 third edition (11.54). The Sec12 identifier is retained solely for compatibility; it does not select Section 12 fair-value guidance as the recognition/hedging authority. This source-reference correction does not implement a valuation or hedge-accounting algorithm. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Assesses eligibility criteria for hedge accounting designation — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied hedge designation eligibility assertion under Section 11 of the February 2025 third edition (11.61–11.75). The Sec12 identifier is retained solely for compatibility; it does not select Section 12 fair-value guidance as the recognition/hedging authority. This source-reference correction does not implement a valuation or hedge-accounting algorithm. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Tests hedge effectiveness within designated risk management parameters — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied hedge effectiveness assertion under Section 11 of the February 2025 third edition (11.61–11.75). The Sec12 identifier is retained solely for compatibility; it does not select Section 12 fair-value guidance as the recognition/hedging authority. This source-reference correction does not implement a valuation or hedge-accounting algorithm. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Defers effective portion of cash flow hedge gains/losses in OCI — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied cash-flow hedge accounting assertion under Section 11 of the February 2025 third edition (11.61–11.75). The Sec12 identifier is retained solely for compatibility; it does not select Section 12 fair-value guidance as the recognition/hedging authority. This source-reference correction does not implement a valuation or hedge-accounting algorithm. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Recognizes hedge ineffectiveness immediately in profit or loss — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied hedge ineffectiveness recognition assertion under Section 11 of the February 2025 third edition (11.61–11.75). The Sec12 identifier is retained solely for compatibility; it does not select Section 12 fair-value guidance as the recognition/hedging authority. This source-reference correction does not implement a valuation or hedge-accounting algorithm. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Verifies disclosure of significant accounting policies and measurement bases — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied material-accounting-policy-information disclosure assertion under 8.5. Assess whether the information, considered with the other financial-statement information, could reasonably influence primary-user decisions. The older significant-policy label is not the third-edition criterion. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Verifies disclosures of capital management objectives, policies, and targets — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an entity-supplemental capital-management information assertion. No standalone Section 8 mandate for generic capital objectives, policies and targets is identified in the supplied text; do not count this supplemental control as mandatory SME coverage without a verified specific basis. Additional material information may still be appropriate or required under other applicable disclosures. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Enforces mandatory temporary exception to DTA/DTL recognition for Pillar Two top-up taxes (§29.38) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied Pillar Two exception/disclosure assertion. Paragraph 29.3A requires neither recognition of related deferred-tax assets/liabilities nor the related information otherwise required by 29.39–29.40. In-scope entities disclose use of the exception under 29.42 and separately disclose related current-tax expense/income under 29.43. Paragraph 29.38 is not this exception authority; other income taxes remain separately assessed. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Accounts for joint venture using cost model less impairment — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied joint-entity cost-model assertion, with cost-model eligibility/measurement separately evidenced. Operative 15.19(d) requires aggregate commitments relating to jointly controlled entities, including the entity share of jointly incurred commitments. Introductory amendment summaries do not erase that disclosure. Preserve and independently review the source-summary discrepancy. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Allocates transaction price based on relative stand-alone selling prices (§23.40) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied contract-price allocation assertion. Relative contract-start stand-alone selling-price allocation is governed by 23.42; 23.40 addresses an exemption. Alternative discount/variable allocation under 23.47–23.48 requires evidence that relative allocation does not represent expected entitlement and the alternative does. A legacy residual-approach state is not blanket authority for a full-IFRS residual SSP method; monetary allocation and exemption applicability require separate evidence. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Validates dividend distributions against distributable reserves — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied dividend disclosure assertion. Section 6.6 requires proposed/declared dividends before authorisation not recognised as distributions in the period, their amounts per share, and unrecognised cumulative preference dividends. A legality or distributable-reserves check is supplemental and does not establish these disclosures. The connected typed producer renders explicit scoped facts into a review-required dividend register. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Classifies cash flows from equity issuance, borrowings, and repayments — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied financing classification assertion; the token does not reconcile liabilities or prove supplier-finance disclosures. Section 7.19A separately requires opening-to-closing liability reconciliation across financing cash flows, acquisitions/disposals, FX, fair value and other changes. Supplier-finance 7.19C requires terms, beginning/end carrying and provider-paid amounts/lines, comparable due-date ranges and noncash changes; provider-paid impracticability is not a blanket waiver. Connected typed producers create review-required documents without native monetary allocation. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Verifies structural ordering and cross-referencing between statements and notes — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied note-structure assertion. Present notes systematically as far as practicable and cross-reference statement items to related note information under 8.3. The 8.4 order is normal, not an inflexible mandatory sequence; accept a documented systematic alternative. This structure screen does not establish completeness or compliance of the financial note content. Native assertions perform no posting or release and require independently reviewed evidence.

amendments.before: Recognizes government grant when reasonable assurance grant will be received and conditions met — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Measure government grants at fair value. No specified future performance condition: recognise income when receivable. Specified future conditions: recognise income when met. Receipts before recognition criteria are liabilities; tax assistance is assessed separately. The linked rem-grant control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Recognizes unconditional grant immediately in profit or loss — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Measure government grants at fair value. No specified future performance condition: recognise income when receivable. Specified future conditions: recognise income when met. Receipts before recognition criteria are liabilities; tax assistance is assessed separately. The linked rem-grant control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Assesses substantial modification of debt terms (10% test) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Apply the substantial-difference/substantial-modification assessment in 11.37; no universal ten-percent rule is prescribed there. Separately identify any implementation guidance and qualitative evidence. The linked rem-debt-modification control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Constrains variable consideration to amount highly probable not to reverse — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Constrain estimated variable consideration to the amount to which entitlement is highly probable on resolution. Use a supported consistent estimate method and update at reporting date; full-IFRS reversal wording is not a substitute. The linked rem-variable-consideration control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Reviews useful life, residual value, and depreciation method at year end — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Separate internal annual review scheduling from indicator-triggered estimate reassessment under 17.19 and reporting-date impairment indicator assessment under Section 27. Internal annual policy does not mandate automatic annual impairment measurement. The linked rem-asset-review control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Tests intangible assets for impairment under Section 27 — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Separate internal annual review scheduling from indicator-triggered estimate reassessment under 17.19 and reporting-date impairment indicator assessment under Section 27. Internal annual policy does not mandate automatic annual impairment measurement. The linked rem-asset-review control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Calculates goodwill as consideration transferred plus NCI less net identifiable assets — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Include acquisition-date fair value of previously held interests in staged-acquisition goodwill. Remeasure the prior holding through profit or loss under 19.29. Do not recognise bargain gain before reassessing acquisition inputs; prior OCI follows its applicable requirements. The linked rem-goodwill control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Recognizes acquiree identifiable assets and liabilities at fair value — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Deferred tax acquired in a business combination uses Section 29 and employee benefit arrangements use Section 28; do not apply generic fair-value acquisition measurement to these exceptions. The linked rem-acquisition-exceptions control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Measures equity-settled share-based payment at grant date fair value — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. For employees/similar services use granted equity-instrument fair value at grant date. Other parties use reliable goods/services fair value, otherwise equity-instrument fair value, at receipt/service date; classify counterparty and settlement type first. The linked rem-share-payment control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Measures consideration transferred at fair value including contingent consideration — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Acquisition-date contingent consideration uses fair value when reliably available without undue cost or effort, otherwise most likely amount. Initial undue-cost basis is not reassessed later. Equity is not remeasured; other consideration follows current fair value or most-likely basis and profit-or-loss changes. The linked rem-contingent control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Triggers liquidation basis accounting when operational continuity ceases — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Assess going concern under 3.8–3.9. Non-going-concern preparation requires disclosure of fact, separately supported basis and reasons; no automatic liquidation valuation follows from the label. The linked rem-going-concern control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Classifies liabilities as current based on settlement within 12 months — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Use all four current-liability OR criteria in 4.7 and the residual 4.8 classification. Missing contract/right evidence is unresolved if no known current criterion settles the outcome. The linked rem-liability-classification control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Tracks OCI items not reclassifiable to profit or loss (revaluations, actuarial) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Include foreign-operation exchange differences among OCI that is not subsequently recycled to profit or loss. Distinguish qualifying hedge reclassification under 11.69; other OCI follows its specific source. The linked rem-oci control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Selects cost, fair value, or equity method for investments in separate FS — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Separate statements permit cost less impairment, fair value through profit or loss, or equity method under 9.26, consistently within each investment class with 9.27 disclosures. The linked rem-separate-policy control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Evaluates exposure to variable returns from involvement with investee — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Returns can vary through investee performance including credit/default exposure despite fixed contractual amounts. Assess power, variable returns, their link and principal/agent status together. The linked rem-control-returns control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Applies changes in accounting estimates prospectively in P&L — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. An estimate change adjusts related asset/liability/equity carrying amount in the change period under 10.17 where applicable; otherwise recognise prospectively in current or current/future profit or loss. Policy changes and errors use their separate routes. The linked rem-estimate-change control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Enforces conditions for applying fair value option to financial instruments — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Require the applicable SME Part I/II basis. Basic debt uses amortised cost except supported current undiscounted cases; qualifying equity follows 11.14(c). No arbitrary full-IFRS fair-value election is established. The linked rem-instrument-basis control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Maps Level 2 inputs: directly or indirectly observable market data — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Classify the entire fair-value measurement at the lowest-level significant input, even where observable inputs are also present. Input hierarchy classification is not itself a valuation. The linked rem-fv-hierarchy control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Enforces FIFO or weighted average cost formula for inventory valuation — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Specific identification takes precedence for non-interchangeable items or segregated projects. Other inventories use FIFO or weighted average consistently for similar nature/use; LIFO is not permitted. The linked rem-inventory-formula control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Assesses significant influence presumption (20% to 50% voting power) — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Apply the rebuttable twenty-percent significant-influence presumption with participation rights, contrary evidence and exclusion of control/joint control. Do not impose a rigid twenty-to-fifty ownership band. The linked rem-significant-influence control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Selects cost model or fair value model for associate investments in separate FS — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Separate-statement associate policies follow the three 9.26 choices. Section 14 applies in its own scope with a published-quotation fair-value exception to the cost model. The linked rem-associate-basis control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Recognizes joint operator share of assets, liabilities, revenues, and expenses — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Establish contractual joint control and arrangement type. Operations recognise own assets/liabilities/expenses and revenue share; assets distinguish own and jointly incurred obligations; entities use their investment model. Do not allocate every item mechanically by ownership percentage. The linked rem-joint-arrangement control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Measures investment property at cost less accumulated depreciation under Section 17 when FV unavailable — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. On loss of supported fair value, dated carrying value becomes Section 17 cost; apply depreciation, impairment and supported capital/restoration changes without resetting to original purchase cost. Return to the applicable fair-value model when reliable FV becomes available. Disclose the change of circumstances. The linked rem-investment-property control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Accounts for PPE revaluation surplus in OCI and deficit in P&L — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Split revaluation changes using the same asset history: increases reverse prior profit-or-loss decreases before OCI; decreases consume that asset surplus before profit or loss. Entire-class revaluation and supported fair value remain prerequisites. The linked rem-revaluation control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Depreciates major components of PPE separately when useful lives differ — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Consider significantly different benefit-consumption patterns independently of numeric life differences; allocate initial cost and support each major component life before separate depreciation. The linked rem-components control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Enforces mandatory expensing of all internal research and development costs — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Expense internally generated intangible/R&D expenditure unless it forms part of another asset meeting that section recognition criteria. Never reactivate previously expensed intangible expenditure; the other-asset exception is not permission to capitalise an internal intangible. The linked rem-internal-expenditure control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Amortises finite-life intangible asset systematically over useful life — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. For intangibles, the revenue-based amortisation presumption may be rebutted by revenue-defined rights or demonstrated high benefit-consumption correlation under 18.22A. PPE revenue-based depreciation is not appropriate under 17.22. The linked rem-amortisation control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Measures dividend payable in non-cash assets at fair value of assets distributed — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. 22.18A expressly permits carrying-amount measurement when reliable fair value is unavailable without undue cost or effort, with 22.20 fact/reasons disclosure. Reassess FV availability before settlement; separate same-ultimate-control exclusions and settlement profit/loss. The linked rem-noncash-distribution control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Reconciles fair value of plan assets discounting expected returns and contributions — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. Use reporting-date plan-asset fair value under 28.15(b), separately reconciling contributions, benefits paid, actual returns and other changes under 28.41(f). Do not value plan assets by discounting expected returns or contributions. The linked rem-plan-assets control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Restates comparative financial statement amounts in measuring unit at reporting date — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. State comparative information in reporting-date purchasing-power units using a supported general price index. This is not closing-exchange-rate translation; current monetary items and net monetary gain/loss follow separate Section 31 treatment. The linked rem-purchasing-power control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Overrides going concern status if operating results deteriorate drastically after period end — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. A deterioration flag in the subsequent-event process does not automatically override going concern. Reassess substantive management intentions/realistic alternatives and the separately supported basis/disclosures under 3.8–3.9. The linked rem-later-going-concern control is advisory and requires scoped source/fact evidence and independent review; this native recognizer performs no financial calculation, posting or release.

amendments.before: Recognizes financial asset for service concession arrangement with unconditional right to receive cash — recognizes an externally supplied assertion; does not compute the accounting determination.
amendments.after: Recognizes an externally supplied assertion. A single concession contract can contain both an unconditional grantor payment right and a user-charge right. Recognise supported financial/intangible components separately and reconcile consideration without double counting; subsequent treatment routes to Sections 11/18 and service revenue to Section 23.
